title: Orderliness Standard
summary: Orderliness is a shared responsibility. Every therapist is expected to keep work areas, treatment rooms, staff areas, equipment, and personal belongings properly arranged and maintained as part of everyday work culture.

sections.title: The Standard
paragraphs: At Zura Spa, orderliness is a shared responsibility. Every therapist is expected to keep their work area, treatment rooms, staff areas, equipment, and personal belongings properly arranged and maintained.

The Spa should always feel clean, organized, calm, and welcoming. Orderliness should not only be observed when management is present or when a client is expected; it should be part of our everyday work culture.

sections.title: Relevance of Orderliness
list: Creates a professional and welcoming environment for clients.
Makes the Spa safer and easier to work in.
Helps therapists work efficiently without unnecessary distractions.
Protects Spa equipment and supplies from damage or loss.
Promotes hygiene and cleanliness.
Reduces confusion and unnecessary delays.
Demonstrates discipline and respect for the workplace.
Creates a better working environment for the entire team.
Reflects the overall standard and image of Zura Spa.

sections.title: Therapist's Mindset Towards Orderliness
paragraphs: Therapists should understand that orderliness is not the responsibility of management, cleaners, or the next therapist—it is everyone's responsibility.
The right mindset should be: "I should leave every space better and more organized than I found it."
Therapists should not wait to be instructed before putting things in their proper place. Being organized should become a habit and part of professional discipline.
A therapist should also understand that someone else having the responsibility to clean does not give them permission to create unnecessary mess.

sections.title: What Therapists Should Do
list: Keep treatment rooms neat and properly arranged.
Return equipment and supplies to their designated places after use.
Keep personal belongings properly stored.
Replace items that need to be replenished or inform the appropriate person when supplies are low.
Keep towels, linens, oils, and other materials properly arranged.
Clean up immediately after creating a mess.
Maintain order in shared staff areas.
Ensure rooms are properly prepared before receiving a client.
Report damaged or misplaced equipment to management.
Encourage one another to maintain the Spa's standards.

sections.title: What Therapists Should Not Do
list: Do not leave used items scattered around the Spa.
Do not leave treatment rooms untidy after a session.
Do not leave personal belongings in inappropriate areas.
Do not take supplies or equipment from their designated locations without reason.
Do not assume that another therapist will clean up after you.
Do not ignore a mess simply because you did not create it.
Do not hide damaged, missing, or misplaced items.
Do not wait for management to repeatedly remind you to maintain order.
Do not treat shared spaces as personal spaces.

sections.title: Zura Spa Mindset
paragraphs: Cleanliness shows care. Orderliness shows discipline. Consistency shows professionalism.
At Zura Spa, orderliness is not about perfection; it is about responsibility, consideration, and maintaining a standard that everyone can rely on.
Keep it clean. Keep it organized. Keep it professional. Protect the Zura Spa standard.

remember: Leave every space better and more organized than you found it. Keep it clean. Keep it organized. Keep it professional.
